criterion: Loading states: spinner or context for a long wait
description: After clicking Try again the only feedback is the label changing to a disabled, dimmed 'Trying again…' for about 13 s in my run (up to 30 s possible per the story). No spinner, no explanation; the notice text above stays unchanged. The button grows from 82x32 to about 108 px wide, so it shifts. Timeline (fetch hook): click at 3.4 s, inbox/refresh sent 3.5 s, answered 16.7 s, button back to 'Try again' at 16.7 s.
expected: Visible progress (spinner) and some sign that it is waiting for Gmail; stable button width.
actual: Looks like a dimmed button with static text; could look stuck on a longer wait.
suggested_fix: Add the existing small spinner to the button and set a min-width; optionally change the line to 'Waiting for Gmail…' while retrying.

criterion: Feedback: result of the action is visible
description: When the retry fails again, the screen returns to exactly the prior state (same title, same text, same button), so the user cannot tell a retry happened.
expected: Small confirmation of the new failed attempt, or a changed hint.
suggested_fix: Show 'Still limited, tried just now' or similar for a moment.
